title: Tea

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Tea
source.note: Đã rút gọn và đơn giản hoá nhẹ một số câu; thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Tea is a drink made from the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant. After water, tea is the most widely drunk drink in the world. Sometimes people use the word “tea” for drinks made by soaking fruit or herbs in hot water, like rosehip tea or chamomile tea. These are called herbal teas.

There are three main types of tea: black tea, oolong tea and green tea. To make black tea, people dry the leaves with hot air until they turn brown or black. Most black tea comes from Sri Lanka, Indonesia and eastern Africa. In China, black tea is often called red tea, because the tea in the cup looks deep dark red.
Green tea is made by steaming fresh leaves. This keeps them green. Then the leaves are crushed and dried in ovens. Oolong tea is a traditional Chinese tea.

Tea is mainly grown in China, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Japan, Nepal, Australia, Argentina and Kenya. Green tea is usually left in hot water for two to three minutes, but black tea needs three to five minutes in boiling water. Earl Grey is a black tea with bergamot oil.
